# name: The birth of Hunahpu and Xbalanque; their elder brothers become monkeys
# title: Are chic xchi ca ꜩihoh calaxic
# fols: fols. 18r–19r
Are chic xchi ca ꜩihoh calaxic Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Arecut calaxic vae xchi ca biyh. Ta xuric vꜫih calaxic, ta xalan puch ri capoh Xquic vbi. Macu xu vachih atit ta xe alaxic; libah chi xe yaqueic e caib chi calaxic, Hunahpu, Xbalanque qui bi; pa huiub xe yaque vi.

Ta xe oc cut pa ha; macu que varic. “He a ꜩaca vloc; quiꜩih chach qui chi,” xꜭha ri atit. Catecut ta xe ya pa zanic; quz cu qui varam chiri. Xe el chicu chiri, xe ya chic chuvi quix.

Are ta cut xcah Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, xe cam ta chiri pa zanic, xe cam ta pu chuvi quix; xcah rumal qui chaquimal, qui ꜫaꜫvachibal puch cumal Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen. Maui xe culax pa ha cumal qui chac nabec; xa maui quetaam, xavi cu pa huiub xe quiy vi.

E cu nimac ahzu, ahbix ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen. Xe nimaquir cut nima caxcol rail; xe icou vi, xe caxcobizaxic; e nimac etamanel chic xe uxic. Xavi xere e ahzu, e ahbix, e pu ahzibab, ahcot xe uxic; ronohel chuꜩin cumal.

Xa xquetaam vi xe alaxic, xa xe nauinac e pu vꜫexel qui cahau ri xebe chi Xibalba, caminac vi qui cahau. E cu nimac etamanel ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen; chi qui ꜭux ronohel nabec quetaam ta xe vinaquir ri qui chac.

Macu xel apanoc qui nauiquil rumal qui ꜫaꜫvachibal; xa chiquih xcah vi vyoc qui ꜭux; maui banoh xe poizaxic cumal ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Xa cu vvbanic chi qui bano hutaꜫih; maui que loꜫoxic rumal ri ratit, Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen; maui chi ia qui va; xhaninac vaim, xe pu vainac ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, ta que vlic.

Macu que cacaric, oiouaric; xa chi qui cuya. Xere quetaam ri qui ꜭoheic, queheri zac ca quilo. Cucaam cut qui ꜯiquin ta que vlic hutaꜫih; chi qui ti cut ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen; mahabi naquila chi ia chiquech, qui cabichal ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Xa cu zu, xa pu bix chi qui bano Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen. Ta xe vl chi puch ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque, mahabi chic qui ꜯiquin cucaam; xe oc vloc, xcacar curi atit.

“Naquipa rumal mahabi chi ꜯiquin iucaam?” xe vꜭhax cut ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

“Are vi, ix catit: xa mi xe tanatob ca ꜯiquin chuvi che,” xꜭha cut. “Macu habi chacan chuvi che chiquech, ix catit. Chi cah ta pu ri caꜩ, que be ta cuꜭ, chi be ta qui cazah vloc ri ꜯiquin,” xeꜭha cut.

“Vꜩ bala; coh be iuvꜭ zaquiric,” xeꜭha curi caꜩ, ta xe chacouic.

Xcaminac cut qui naoh qui cabichal chirech qui chaquic Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen: “Xa ca ꜩolcomih qui ꜭoheic, eu pam; ca ꜩih ta chuxoc rumal nima caxcol mi xqui ban chique. Xoh cam tah, xoh zach tah puch, xcah ri oh qui chac. Queheri ala xoh pe vi vloc chi qui ꜭux; quehe cut que ca chac vi; xa retal chi ca bano,” xeꜭha chi quibil quib.

Ta xebe cut chila chuxe che Cante vbi; cachbilan curi caꜩ ta xebec; xqui tiquiba chicut vvbanic. Maui ahilan chi ꜯiquin chuvi che que chitihc; xe maihan cut ri caꜩ ta xquil ri ꜯiquin.

“Are curi ꜯiquin, mahabi hun oc xcah vloc chuxe che; ri ca ꜯiquin e maui que cah vloc; xa hix cazah vloc,” xeꜭha cut chire caꜩ. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.

Catepuch xe acanic chuvi che; xnimar cut ri che, xzipoh vpam. Catecut xe rah cah vloc, macu vꜩ chic qui cahic vloc chuvi che Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen.

Xeꜭha cu vloc chuvi che: “Hupacha coh vchanic, ix ca chac? Tocob ca vach! Are ri che ca xibin chic ca quilo, ix ca chac,” xecha vloc chuvi che.

Xeꜭha curi Hunahpu, Xbalanque: “Chi quira iuex, chi xima xe i pam; nahlic vꜩam chi hure he chivih; catecut vꜩ i binic,” xe vꜭhax chic cumal qui chac.

“Vve,” xecha cut, ta xqui huruba cut vꜩam qui toc. Xa pu huzu qui he chi xuxic; xa coy xqui vachibeh chic.

Catecut xebe chuvi tac che, chuti huyub, nima huyub; xebec pa tac quichelah, que vohon chic, qui zilah chic chu cab tac che. Quehe cut qui chacatahic Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque; xa rumal qui naual ta xqui bano.

Ta xe opon cut chi cochoch. Xeꜭha cut, xe oponic ruꜭ catit, ruꜭ pu qui chuch: “Ix catit, naquila mi xqui culvachih ri caꜩ? Xa rax qui vach mi xebec, queheri e chicop chic,” xeꜭha cut.

“Ve naquila mi xiban chique ivaꜩ, mi xin icalaba, mi pu xin ichiquiba. Mata quehe xiban chique ivaꜩ, ix vi,” xꜭha ri atit chiquech Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

Xeꜭha chicut chire catit: “Mi xbizonic, ix catit; xchivil chic qui vach ri caꜩ; xque vlic. Xere chicut vtihouic va chive, ix catit; taqui mi xꜩeenic. Cahhana qui ꜫih,” xeꜭha cut.

Catepuch xqui tiquiba zuanic, Hunahpu Coy xqui zuah.
